thread:
ana (PM): Quick sync: propose carving a tight observability MVP for Console focused on customer asks: (A) per-route cost heatmap + gzipped CSV export, (B) latency spike -> trace deep-link, (C) error-regression widget with grouped alerts. Goal: pilot in 2 sprints. Thoughts?
kai (eng): Agree. Tech needs: route tagging at ingress (route_id), tokens metric tagged, a read-optimized view for UI queries. Estimate ~6 dev-days total if we skip backfill. Export endpoint + gzipping + rate-limit ~1.5 days.
ruth (sre): Sampling is essential. Recommend default 0.5% for high QPS routes; full capture on error signatures. Expose trace_id header only when admin toggle enabled. Alerting: group by fingerprint and rate-limit per-customer.
mina (design): I'll design three compact cards: heatmap (rows=routes, cols=times), latency card with big "Open trace" CTA on spikes, and error card with signature grouping. Mobile-first mocks by Thu.
leo (cs): Customers requested timezone-aware CSVs, columns: start,end,route,deploy_id,tokens,est_usd. Need admin-only export toggle and PII opt-out. Dedicated/Private customers are highest priority.
ci-bot: CI build feature/obs-mvp passed :white_check_mark:.
nana (PM): (typo) meant ana :) Launch criteria draft: templates in Console, one pilot using export+trace links, ops runbook for sampling and alert rules, docs. No historical backfill for GA. Target: end of sprint 4.
kai (eng): Risks: tagging rollout needs feature flag; historical backfill heavy -> defer to post-GA. Also validate header exposure policy for hosted.
ruth (sre): Ops note: example sampling config to land in docs:
```yaml
tracing:
  default_sample: 0.005
  full_on_error: true
  expose_header: false
```
nana (PM): Action items: @kai spike on tagging+export (due 2026-04-04), @mina mocks by 2026-03-28, @ruth ops doc by 2026-03-29, @leo confirm pilots this week.
leo (cs): Starting outreach now.
kai (eng): Ack.
mina (design): Ack.
